in_marathi.name: Raveena
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rain, or the one who is beautiful like rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raveena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raveena is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', which means 'rain'. It is also associated with the god Indra, who is known as the lord of rain. The name Raveena is believed to bestow beauty, gentleness, grace, and a calm demeanor upon the child. It is a perfect name for a baby girl born during the monsoon season or for someone who embodies the qualities of the rain.
